column2: Did they do this to you? Hang in there, I'll help you right now...
You two, from back then?
Yeah, thanks to you saving that kid, the money we had coming went poof!
You... You kidnapped that boy, demanded a ransom, and then tried to kill him?!
Yeah, so what? Kill a brat or two and the world won't change one bit.
What we need is money. Money! With money, you can do anything.
You bastards...!
This army... Ngh... At least the cathedral...
The cathedral... What happened to everyone?
Witch
So there's still a priest who hasn't run.
You... This city...
Hm? You... You must be the angel's hero.
But you're too late. Alone, you're helpless against the Empire's army.
Go on, struggle all you like.
It's no use... I can't do anything alone. Damn...
Wait, Viper! I'll have that Demon Stone back.
Tch.
I'll take it back from you by force if I have to.
Hold on... Don't get so worked up.
I'm no good in a fight.
Besides, trying to take back what you lost on a bet by force? That's low.
Makes a man look cheap.
You swindled it out of me... with your devil's cards!
The cards' power is power. I played that game fair and square.
Shut up! Either hand over the Demon Stone quietly or fight me!
All right... I'll give back the Demon Stone... No violence.
I don't really need a thing like this anyway.
What's wrong? Come and get it.
Hand it over, Viper!
No can do... I changed my mind.
Let's go with violence after all.
Here I come!
Viper's Trap (Won)
Tch, you're strong. Pretty strong.
...But I can't give you the Demon Stone. It's my last bit of fun...
So long!
Viper's Trap (Lost)
Hmph... Not bad.
Well, I'll let you live.
